subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Beginning Knowledge: National anthem and coat of arms
source.subtopic: Recognising the coat of arms as the signature of South Africa; include learners from other countries and their flags

show.line: Our coat of arms is South Africa's special badge. Our anthem is our national song!

rounds.prompt: Our national anthem starts Nkosi sikelel'...?
When we sing the anthem we...?
Where can you see the coat of arms?
The anthem uses how many languages? More than one?
Say: I am proudly South African!

hints: The coat of arms is like a country's signature.
We stand when we sing the anthem.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! We stand still with respect.

parent_line: Recognises the coat of arms and knows the national anthem.
